part.title: Epilogue Part 2
part.subtitle: Beecher's Hope
intro: Part 2 is based at Beecher's Hope, west of Blackwater. It has eleven gold-medal missions and one cutscene with no medal.
Two story trophies unlock here automatically: Cowboy Builder (for 'A New Jerusalem') and Endless Summer (for finishing the Epilogue).
Nothing trophy-related can be lost in Part 2. The last Ms. Hobbs hunting request is now available, but hunting requests are handled in the Cleanup part.
Keep a manual save before each mission. After the final mission and the credits, the game returns you to free roam with every mission replayable.

steps.title: Find an old friend in Saint Denis
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
In Saint Denis, head to the fence rather than the bar; speak to the shopkeeper at the door and leave straight away for the next location.
When the enemies appear at the end, tag them all in Dead Eye at once.

steps.title: Note: the last hunting request is now available
how: The fifth Ms. L. Hobbs hunting request (the Van Horn list) only becomes available after Epilogue Part 1.
You need all five for It's Art and 100%, but there is no deadline.
Leave it for the Cleanup part, where the hunting requests and the squirrel statue are handled together.
steps.unverified: Research wording differs slightly: trophies.json says the last request unlocks after Epilogue Part 1; collectibles.json only says 'in the Epilogue'.

steps.title: Clear out the old shack
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Do NOT skip the opening cutscene: skipping adds loading time that counts against the 18-second limit.

steps.title: Recover a bounty
how: Ride to the mission marker at the Blackwater Saloon.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
Take careful, aimed shots to keep your accuracy above 70%.

steps.title: Haul lumber for the ranch
how: Equip two sidearms and use only them for the whole mission.
Start the mission at the marker in Blackwater.
Hip-fire the machete rushers; there is no accuracy objective.
When your companion warns about ambushers in the trees, tag their heads carefully in Dead Eye.
Don't use any health items.

steps.title: Build the house
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Hammer each nail cleanly: sources suggest either rapid presses or holding the button for a split second per nail; use whichever keeps your accuracy above 80%.
Finish the mission: Cowboy Builder unlocks automatically.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on the best nailing technique (rapid presses vs a short hold per nail).

steps.title: Study the ranch dog at Beecher's Hope
steps.where: Beecher's Hope, usually near the front porch
how: Find Rufus, the family dog, near the front porch of the house.
Look at him through your binoculars until he is marked as studied.
steps.tip: Most sources say Rufus is not needed for Zoologist, but studying him takes seconds and removes any doubt.
steps.unverified: Whether Rufus counts for Zoologist is disputed; the usual count of 152 excludes him.

steps.title: Answer a call for help in Rhodes
how: Equip a shotgun, a long scoped rifle and high-damage weapons before starting.
Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Get your 4 hip-fire kills with the shotgun right at the start of the ambush.
Don't use any health items.

steps.title: Mount a rescue in Tall Trees
how: Make sure you have a bow and arrows equipped.
Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Use Dead Eye with the bow: tagged arrows home in, making the 5 bow headshots easy.
Stay just ahead of your companions and clear enemies so they keep moving.
Near the horses, quickly kill the three enemies that appear behind the group.
Don't use any health items.

steps.title: Watch the next cutscene (no medal)
how: 'The Best of Women' is a cutscene with no gold medal.
Afterwards the next two missions open up; they can be done in either order.
steps.unverified: Placement (right after 'Uncle's Bad Day', before 'Trying Again' and 'A Really Big Bastard') comes from web guides; research only records that it has no medal.

steps.title: Go fishing
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Land a fish before the conversation turns to the dog, then put the rod away immediately to stay inside the time limit.

steps.title: Track a bounty in Tall Trees
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Have a fast-firing weapon ready so you can shoot the charging bear 4 times.
Keep Dead Eye topped up for the two rival bounty hunters.

steps.title: Spend a day in Blackwater
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Go straight to each objective; the only gold objective is the time limit.

steps.title: Save before the final mission
how: Make a manual save now in a separate slot.
Nothing trophy-related is lost by finishing the story: every mission can be replayed afterwards and all collectibles stay available.
Optional insurance: study a Carolina Parakeet in the Lemoyne bayou if you haven't yet (one source claims it can disappear).
Put a repeater with high-velocity ammo and a scoped bolt-action rifle in your weapon loadout.
steps.unverified: Only one source (a Codeberg missables list) treats the Carolina Parakeet as missable; others say it is not needed for Zoologist.

steps.title: Play the final mission
how: Equip a repeater with high-velocity ammo and a scoped bolt-action rifle.
Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
For the sniper: advance to the rocks nearest him with your companion, wait for the prompt, then lean out in Dead Eye and tag his head. Leaning out early gets you killed.
Favour body shots to keep accuracy above 85%.
Don't use any health items.
Watch the credits: Endless Summer unlocks for finishing the Epilogue.

steps.title: What unlocks after the credits
how: You receive a $20,000 reward.
The game returns you to free roam at Beecher's Hope, with the whole map (including New Austin) open.
Replay any story mission, including optional ones you missed, from Pause > Progress > Story to earn gold medals; Gold Rush needs 70 of the 104.
Replays do NOT count for Lending a Hand.
Carry on with the Cleanup part: gold medals, collectibles, challenges and 100%.
spoiler: You can also pick up Micah's Revolver at the final showdown location on Mount Hagen.
steps.unverified: The Micah's Revolver pick-up comes from a single source (Steam 100% guide).
